data.notes: The review gets the header right and correctly gives the value case built on the customer's data as the real reason. It also catches the CFO's month-end close as the trigger and keeps Fiserv's pitch unknown without stating a dollar figure. It misses two insights: the first proposal was written about the portal and never spoke to the decider, and the undemoed branch-reader gap is an unproven in-store promise that carries into rollout.
